run_id.description: Unique identifier for this assessment execution, e.g. run-20261106-01

owner.description: Tên hoặc mã thành viên phụ trách (TV1, TV2, TV3, TV4 hoặc Lê Anh Quân)

cis_status.description: A = Automated, M = Manual as defined in CIS Benchmark

target.description: Target hostname, node identifier or cluster name (e.g. cass-dev1, CISLab)

actual.description: Masked actual configuration state observed on the target

expected.description: Expected configuration state based on policy and benchmark

evidence.description: Sanitized/masked command output, file snippet, or path to evidence log

policy_ref.description: Path or identifier of the policy applied (e.g. policies/lab.yml)

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this status was determined
